title: CHS-H-47-51 JACOBSEN - 1002 53rd street Moline, IL

onscreen_lines.desc: Location: 1 - Basement Trade: 22 - Plumbing 6700 - FLOOR DRAIN/BASEMENT/BATHROOM - 2.0 LF Address two non-functioning floor drains in the main basement room. We have already completed the replacement of water supply lines, water heater, and drain, waste, and vent stack in the basement through the Critical Assistance Program in 2025. Continue with sewer drain repairs. Enclose the work area with plastic to limit concrete dust from spreading throughout the basement and home. Remove and replace two basement floor drains. One is in the main basement room, and the second is in the basement bathroom shower floor area. Bring the basement bathroom area and drains up to code. Break and clear the concrete around the old drain. Cut and remove the damaged pipe and P-trap. Install a new code-compliant PVC P-trap assembly with backflow prevention, connect with a shielded rubber coupling, backfill with gravel, and patch the floor with new concrete sloped toward the drain. Test for proper installation and water flow. If the underground drain line leading to the main sewer is collapsed, crushed, or heavily rusted, replace the extended pipe. Include repair of all tear-out, including cement work and wall framing.
